name: @local/dsh-sac-compact
description: Single-Action Compaction (SAC) context compression policy for the DeepSeek Harness — fold completed actions into a compact semantic state (arXiv:2611.05306). 1.1.0 adds the 128K-optimized paper pipeline (lean state updates, oversized-observation trim, recap word cap, hard context budget). 1.2.0 pins every user instruction, anchors the state update on the request it belongs to, and archives older requests verbatim. 1.3.0 adds cost-aware folding (size trigger, gain guard, harness-written digests, bounded and untruncated recaps).
